name: Basel

items.label: Taxable income (Basel-Stadt)
items.note: Net salary less the CHF 4,200 professional costs lump sum, the CHF 4,200 insurance premiums lump sum and the CHF 19,500 social deduction for a single person, rounded down to CHF 100.

items.label: Cantonal income tax (Basel-Stadt)
items.note: Tariff A: 21% up to CHF 212,500, 27.25% up to CHF 316,300 and 28.25% above, charged at 100%. The city of Basel levies no income tax of its own. No church tax.

notModelled: Pillar 3a contributions and other personal deductions
Actual professional costs above the lump sum
Riehen and Bettingen, which add their own communal tax
provisional: The amounts are those indexed from 2025, which the Basel-Stadt government decided to keep for 2026 (no cold-progression adjustment)

sources.title: Basel-Stadt Regierungsrat — Kein Ausgleich der kalten Progression ab Steuerperiode 2026

obtainedFrom.title: Official documents, Nov 2026
obtainedFrom.note: Tariff A, social deduction (19,500), insurance lump sum (4,200), professional costs lump sum (4,200) and the 100% multiplier from the ESTV Kantonsblatt (indexed amounts from 2025); no adjustment for 2026 per the Regierungsrat decision of 28 October 2025; no communal income tax in the city of Basel (§ 2 StG).

tests.note: Federal and social as in Zurich (AHV 5,300, ALV 1,100, federal tax 1,951.75). Basel taxable 93,600 − 4,200 − 4,200 − 19,500 = 65,700; tax 21% = 13,797.
